from pathlib import Path
p=Path(wd)/'programs/task-a83e8747.py'; p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    g=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])\n    centers=[]\n    # detect monochrome 3x3 squares\n    for r in range(R-2):\n        for c in range(C-2):\n            v=g[r][c]\n            if v and all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(r,r+3) for j in range(c,c+3)):\n                if not any((rr,cc,v)==(r,c,v) for rr,cc,v in centers): centers.append((r+1,c+1,v))\n    rays={}\n    for r,c,v in centers:\n        for j in range(C): rays[(r,j)]=v\n        for i in range(R): rays[(i,c)]=v\n    # At intersections of rays from different blocks, leave blank.\n    for (i,j),v in rays.items():\n        vals={w for rr,cc,w in centers if (i==rr or j==cc)}\n        if len(vals)>1: g[i][j]=0\n        else: g[i][j]=v\n    return g\n'''
